note: Known, intentional divergences between the PUBLIC @givecare/tools scoring definition (canonical for the public SDOH instrument) and the PRIVATE GiveCare production runtime (../gc-sms/src/scoring.ts). gc-tools owns the public definition; production is allowed to differ on the dimensions listed below. A new divergence on one of these dimensions beyond what is declared here is a test failure — either fold it back to the public definition or update this manifest with a reason.
verifiedBy: src/__tests__/productionDelta.test.ts (runs against the ../gc-sms sibling when present; skips cleanly when absent)
scopeNote: This manifest tracks SCORING and INSTRUMENT-SET divergences only. Production also carries SMS-tuned question wording and a yes/no SDOH-6 framing that the public conversational copy does not; that wording is intentionally NOT parity-locked to the public SDK (the two PUBLIC copies — gc-tools and gc-evals — gate each other on question text; production is documented-divergent, not text-coupled).

divergences.reason: Production renamed the top risk band 'critical' -> 'severe'. Same 4-tier structure; a display-label divergence only.

The public GiveCare Score is a simplified ZONE-weighted 0-100 composite (ZONE_WEIGHTS). Production weights by INSTRUMENT (sdoh6 0.4 / sdoh30 0.3 / ema3 0.2 / bsfc 0.1) and renormalizes over whichever components are present.

BSFC-s (Burden Scale for Family Caregivers, short form) is (c) 1999 Tebb / Berg-Weger / Rubio; redistribution rights are unconfirmed. It is deliberately excluded from the public repos and scored only in production (scoreBsfc, from the web-score intake).
